messages.subject: best way to add packages not in CRAN as dependencies?
messages.subject_clean: best way to add packages not in CRAN as dependencies?
messages.body_plain:
Hi everybody,
I am developing a package that has a few dependencies not hosted on CRAN (most of it are git repositories hosted in different platform like github and bitbucket).

What is the best way to have R treat these packages as dependencies?

So far I have used a naive approach and I check for them in the .onLoad function,
but this prevents me to import the packages, since before the .onLoad is executed they are still not installed.

Any advice on how to handle this situation?

Cheers,
Luca
